title: Subscription contract
description: Language-neutral subscription/entitlement shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. subscriptionRecord mirrors the Firestore `subscriptions/{uid}` document: owner-readable, written by Cloud Functions ONLY after verification (or an audited admin manual grant) — no client writes, not even admin clients. Raw purchase tokens are never stored, logged, or returned; only the SHA-256 hash. Suspension and deletion always override entitlement. subscription.verify fails closed until store credentials are configured (end-of-MVP setup). Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

subscriptionPlatform.description: manual = audited admin grant (admin.grantEntitlement), the operational path until store verification is wired.

subscriptionStatus.description: active and grace_period grant access (legacy isSubscriptionActiveStatus).

purchaseTokenHash.description: SHA-256 of the purchase token; null for manual grants. The raw token never exists in storage.

verifySubscriptionRequest.description: Input for subscription.verify. Fails closed (failed-precondition) until the platform's provider is configured.
